name: Linux Host (SSH)
description: Credentials for authenticated Linux audit over SSH via the relay agent. The ReAct agent reads a curated allowlist of system files (/etc/os-release, sshd_config, /etc/passwd, sudoers, crontabs) and runs read-only inspection commands (ss, ps, find, dpkg/rpm/apk) to surface hardening, identity, and software-inventory exposures.

steps.instruction: Enter the SSH username on the target host. Prefer a dedicated low-privilege audit account (e.g. 'svc-hakuna-audit'). Root is not required — the agent degrades gracefully when a probe needs elevation it doesn't have.
Password (optional if using a private key). Stored AES-256-GCM encrypted in the credential vault.
Private key in PEM format (optional if using a password). Paste the full key including the BEGIN/END lines. OpenSSH and PKCS#8 formats are both supported.
Passphrase for the private key (if the key is encrypted). Leave blank for an unencrypted key.

note.label: Note
note.description: This connector stores credentials only. Audits are triggered from the 'SSH Audit' page — a connected relay agent with SSH reachability to the target is required.
